title: Skywatcher sees orange orbs over Picatinny Arsenal during the New Jersey drone wave

tellings.quote: So that being said, we show up in New Jersey first night on location within 30 minutes over Pikatin Arsenal. Wopw all these orange orbs come into existence right over Pikatini Arsenal.

plain: Jake Barber, who says he once flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, says that in 2024, while there was a wave of reported drone sightings over New Jersey, his team from the startup Skywatcher went to Picatinny Arsenal, a US military site there. He says that on their first night, within 30 minutes, many orange orbs appeared right over the base. If true, it would tie the mystery lights directly to a military site.
